package courseplan

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

func TestSelectRequestedTargetClosureIncludesTransitivePrerequisites(t *testing.T) {
	graph := testGoalGraph()
	requested := graph.Targets[len(graph.Targets)-1].Ref
	selected, err := SelectRequestedTargetClosure(graph, []domain.TargetRef{requested})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("select closure: %v", err)
	}
	if len(selected.Targets) != len(graph.Targets) {
		t.Fatalf("expected all prerequisites, got %d of %d", len(selected.Targets), len(graph.Targets))
	}
}

func TestSelectRequestedTargetClosureRejectsUnknownSkill(t *testing.T) {
	_, err := SelectRequestedTargetClosure(testGoalGraph(), []domain.TargetRef{{
		Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: "go.unknown", Version: "v1",
	}})
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected unknown target rejection")
	}
}
